metadata.description:
A perpetual collection of retro videogame books of the fiction variety.


Novels, children's books, "choose your own adventures," gamebooks, and interactive computer stories.

As more are collected, or whenever the 15+ year mark rolls around each year past the original publication, more items will be added. When that happens, you will find updates placed below this post.

Current file size (uncompressed): 2.77 GB
Format: pdf, .epub, .cbz, .mobi, .azw, and .cbr

Files in this collection: 187

reviews.reviewbody: While your selection is quite impressive, I couldn't help but notice the absence of the Sonic Adventure Gamebooks--not the Ladybird ones, which are already included, but the ones like "The Zone Zapper", "Metal City Mayhem", and "Sonic V. Zonik", which are impossible to find anywhere else!
A huge selection of books, many of which I never would have known about or read if it wasn't for this collection, you really are the retro game champ!
